Alex — thanks for the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and agreed next steps so we have the same plan: 

- Goal: validate ByteSoft search assistant integration with two production endpoints and measure latency/cost delta.
- Success criteria: < 150ms median p99 tail for 1k qps sim, accuracy within 5% of baseline for reranking.
- Agreed trial scope: 14-day dedicated trial (1 GPU reserved) starting with a 1:1 kickoff to provision keys and mapping.

I attached the trial playbook and a short checklist to help your infra and security teams. Can you confirm who on your side will be the technical owner for provisioning (I think Daniel was going to be involved)? Once you confirm, we’ll schedule the 30–45 minute kickoff and provision the trial environment.

Attachments: redwood-trial-playbook.xlsx, poc-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik
